digest.component_or_area: development-process audit reconciliation and decision history
propositions: The escaped-defect metadata recommendation should preserve fail-open, zero-friction captured detection metadata and expand automatic stamping at known filer boundaries, targeting near 100% coverage for automated agents without global requirement or backfilling unverifiable history.

The deterministic plan preflight recommendation should extend the existing P1-P11 floor only for recurrent, mechanically decidable failure classes validated offline against pass/block cohorts with explicit false-positive ceilings and fail-open behavior, preserving semantic LLM review for architecture and tradeoffs.

The completion-failure classification recommendation should first derive stable categories offline from existing 351 failure sidecars with 682 structured findings before adding schema, validating classifier agreement and avoiding parallel telemetry.

The risk-tiered review recommendation should pilot risk reporting without hard merge enforcement, evaluating signals including security/store surfaces, planned file impact, module complexity, and actual diff breadth, measuring defects and override frequency before choosing thresholds.

The proactive debt management recommendation should remove the 720-LOC soft warning from future work because it is already shipped, prioritizing debt remediation only where near-cap size intersects complexity, churn, or defects in validated clone families and architectural seams.

The maintainership/reviewer breadth recommendation should not add human approval requirements or reviewer rotation; instead durably distinguish author and reviewer agent/model provenance, monitor provider diversity and autonomous-assurance independence, and test recovery paths for critical providers and operator continuity.
